standard-dialogue-if-the-seal-of-passage.player: Hi! What are you up to?

standard-dialogue-if-the-seal-of-passage.npc: Watering the pretty flowers, you want to help?

standard-dialogue-if-the-seal-of-passage.player: I don't have time to water flowers, I have people to save!

standard-dialogue-if-the-seal-of-passage.npc: Pft, you should take time to enjoy the simple things.
What are you doing here, Fremennik?!

standard-dialogue-if-the-seal-of-passage.player: I have a seal of pass...

standard-dialogue-if-the-seal-of-passage.text: The player is teleported back to Rellekka

standard-dialogue-if-the-seal-of-passage.player: Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
